resolution: User proposed replacing the mesh painter's per-stroke PNG blob (the 695MB model-store bloat) with the pixel_icon palette-indexed RLE format. Built+tested the codec (paintMatrix.ts, 6/6 round-trip, commit f4c78b66f), then measured on REAL stored paint blobs decoded via ImageMagick. Verdict from the data: at 1024² the RLE is 2.4-2.7x LARGER than the existing 158KB PNG because the texture is spatially fragmented (~100k run-entries). Quantizing colours (628->7) and snapping to the 3 real colours did NOT reduce runs — the fragmentation is genuine pixel-level alternation, not colour noise. RLE only wins by dropping resolution (what pixel_icon does at 64²). So the format isn't the lever; retention is (4400 historical copies). Recommended fork: harden the brush to flat 3-colour storage (then RLE wins AND looks crisper) OR compaction (keep PNG, drop hoarded copies, 695MB->few MB). Awaiting user's choice.
